name: talos
description: Talos — an autonomous issue-to-PR pipeline for Claude Code, driven by an orchestrator session rather than CI.

plugins.name: talos
plugins.description: Autonomous issue-to-PR pipeline orchestrated by a Claude Code session. Validator, developer (worktree-isolated), QA, reviewer, security, and docs subagents drive GitHub issues through to merged PRs.

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: Engineering methodology skills (spec, planning, TDD, review, security, docs). Required by talos — its role profiles delegate their methodology to these skills rather than restating it. Catalogued here only so the dependency resolves and auto-installs; upstream is addyosmani/agent-skills (MIT), unmodified.
